data: Which of the following have a precision value greater than 0.8 when the recall value is 0.1?

To determine which models have a precision value greater than 0.8 when the recall value is 0.1, I will analyze the graph at the point where the recall is approximately 0.1. At this point, I will look for lines that intersect the 0.8 mark on the y-axis.

From the graph, I can see that the lines corresponding to $R_{2k}^2$ (Linear), $R_{4k}^2$ (Quadratic), CNN+ATT, and PCNN+ATT all intersect the 0.8 mark on the y-axis at or above the 0.1 mark on the x-axis. Therefore, these four models have a precision value greater than 0.8 when the recall value is 0.1.
